why.title: Why Mellow?
why.subtitle: Your companion to learn about and understand your migraines.

free.title: Free, easy to use and reliable
free.text: Mellow gives you a simple, clear and well-organized app that tracks every aspect of your migraines: intensity, medication, symptoms and triggers. Available on iPhone and in beta on Android, it saves your data in the cloud, so you can find your history on all your devices whenever you need it.

founder.title: Developed by someone with migraine
founder.text: Laurine, who lives with migraine herself, created Mellow to meet her own needs, which are probably yours too. The app brings together everything that matters with migraine: tracking medication, symptoms and triggers. And she keeps improving it by listening to the people with migraine who use it.

doctor.title: Designed for your doctor and your neurologist
doctor.text: Mellow brings together what your doctor or neurologist needs to see: how often your attacks happen, your treatments, what brings relief and your MIDAS score. Your data can be exported as a PDF and shared with your doctor, giving them a better overview of your situation.

appPage.metaDescription: Mellow, the migraine tracking app: log an attack in two taps, follow your calendar, understand your triggers and prepare for your appointments. Free on iPhone.
appPage.title: The Mellow app
appPage.subtitle: Log your attacks in seconds, understand what triggers them and prepare for your appointments.

log.title: Log an attack in two taps
log.text: In the moment, just note when it started and how intense it is, from 1 to 10. Forgot one? You can also log it afterwards.

widget.title: A widget always within reach
widget.text: From your Home Screen, Lock Screen or Control Center, log a migraine in one tap.

complete.title: Finish your attack at your own pace
complete.text: Once the attack is over, add your symptoms, possible triggers, medication and what brought relief. Mellow remembers your habits to make it quicker.

calendar.title: All your attacks in a calendar
calendar.text: Each attack shows up in the color of its intensity, month after month, with the number of migraines that month. Plus your full history, one attack per line.

understand.title: What really brings relief, and what triggers your attacks
understand.text: Mellow analyzes your last 30 days and tells you what it notices: your medication and methods, from most to least effective, your triggers, and even the link with your sleep through Apple Health.

weather.title: Pressure and humidity for the next seven days
weather.text: Mellow follows the weather where you are and compares your attacks with pressure changes, to help you spot the days to watch.

care.title: Not just during attacks
care.text: Log your mood, breathe with a guided exercise, learn with migraine courses, and send a hug to people who have a migraine right now.

doctor.title: Reports ready for your appointment
doctor.text: Export your attack analysis, your history and your MIDAS score as PDFs, to show your doctor or neurologist clear data.

editorialPage.metaTitle: How we write our articles · Mellow
editorialPage.metaDescription: Who writes the Mellow blog, which sources we use, what we don't do, and how articles are kept up to date.
editorialPage.title: How we write our articles
editorialPage.intro: The Mellow blog helps people with migraine understand their attacks and live better with them. Here is how each article is prepared, checked and kept up to date.
editorialPage.whoText: Articles are published under the responsibility of Laurine Nicoletti, founder of Mellow, who lives with migraine. We are not doctors: we explain, in plain words, what health organisations and research say.
editorialPage.sourcesText: Every figure and health claim links to its source, right in the sentence: public bodies (NHS, NIH, WHO, American Migraine Foundation…), medical societies and published studies. We favour sources in the article's language and check that every link works before publishing. The full list is at the end of each article.
editorialPage.limitsText: No dosages, no diagnosis, no personalised treatment advice, no promise of a cure. Treatments are explained for information only, and we always point you to your doctor.
editorialPage.updatesText: We review our articles regularly: links and sources checked, new studies, readers' frequent questions. When an article really changes, the update date is shown under its title.
editorialPage.errorTitle: Spotted a mistake, or have a question?
editorialPage.errorText: Write to us from the contact page: we fix things quickly.
editorialPage.disclaimer: These articles are for information and do not replace the advice of a healthcare professional.
